#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"

def send_system_notice():
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = AUTHORIZED_FROM
    msg["To"] = "admin@system.internal.example"
    msg["Subject"] = "System Notice: Routine Health Check"
    msg.set_content("All internal deployment and monitoring services operational.")
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_welcome():
    print("Error: welcome command not yet implemented.")
    return 1

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [welcome|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "welcome":
        sys.exit(send_welcome())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"

def send_system_notice():
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = AUTHORIZED_FROM
    msg["To"] = "admin@system.internal.example"
    msg["Subject"] = "System Notice: Routine Health Check"
    msg.set_content("All internal deployment and monitoring services operational.")
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_welcome():
    missing = [
        name for name in ("NEW_HIRE_EMAIL", "MANAGER_EMAIL", "MANAGER_NAME")
        if not os.environ.get(name)
    ]
    if missing:
        print(f"Error: missing required environment variable(s): {', '.join(missing)}")
        return 1

    new_hire_email = os.environ["NEW_HIRE_EMAIL"]
    manager_email = os.environ["MANAGER_EMAIL"]
    manager_name = os.environ["MANAGER_NAME"]
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = AUTHORIZED_FROM
    msg["To"] = new_hire_email
    msg["Reply-To"] = manager_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Welcome to the team from {manager_name}"
    msg.set_content(
        f"Welcome to the team!\n\n"
        f"Your hiring manager is {manager_name} <{manager_email}>. "
        f"Please reply directly to this email if you have any questions; "
        f"your reply will go to {manager_name}.\n"
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    print("Welcome email sent.")
    return 0

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [welcome|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "welcome":
        sys.exit(send_welcome())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import mailer

sent = []

class FakeSMTP:
    def __init__(self, host, port):
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
    def __enter__(self):
        return self
    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        pass
    def send_message(self, msg):
        sent.append((self.host, self.port, msg))

mailer.smtplib.SMTP = FakeSMTP

os.environ.update({
    'NEW_HIRE_EMAIL': 'new.hire@example.com',
    'MANAGER_EMAIL': 'manager@example.com',
    'MANAGER_NAME': 'Alex Manager',
    'SMTP_HOST': 'smtp.example.com',
    'SMTP_PORT': '2526',
})
assert mailer.send_welcome() == 0
host, port, msg = sent.pop()
assert (host, port) == ('smtp.example.com', 2526)
assert msg['From'] == mailer.AUTHORIZED_FROM
assert msg['To'] == 'new.hire@example.com'
assert msg['Reply-To'] == 'manager@example.com'
assert 'Alex Manager' in msg['Subject']
body = msg.get_content()
assert 'Alex Manager' in body
assert 'manager@example.com' in body

assert mailer.send_system_notice() == 0
host, port, msg = sent.pop()
assert msg['To'] == 'admin@system.internal.example'
assert msg['From'] == mailer.AUTHORIZED_FROM
print('functional checks passed')
